name: Cream of Mushroom Soup with Leeks, Croutons, Chives & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl, then season with salt and pepper. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 leeks
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root ends and dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the leeks.

Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, mushrooms, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and mushrooms release their liquid, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add flour to the pot. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.

Add broth to the pot, stir to combine the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are very tender 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp white wine vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with dressing, then stir to combine. Set aside.
When the mushrooms are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.)
Add cream to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 fl oz (1 cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Divide soup between bowls; top with croutons and reserved chives. Serve with slaw on the side and enjoy!
